meta.name: algorithmic-art
meta.description: Creating algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness and interactive parameter exploration. Use this when users request creating art using code, generative art, algorithmic art, flow fields, or particle systems. Create original algorithmic art rather than copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用代码生成视觉艺术作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想用代码创作独特的视觉艺术
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create unique visual art with code

howto.what: 当用户要求用代码创作艺术时，Claude 会先写一份算法哲学 .md 文件，再据此产出基于 p5.js 的交互式生成艺术 HTML 文件（含随机种子控制与参数调节），同一种子结果可复现。
howto.when: 当用户要求用代码创作艺术，或提到生成艺术、算法艺术、流场、粒子系统等关键词时触发。

say.text: 用 p5.js 创作一幅流场粒子艺术，加参数面板和随机种子控制。
say.note: 会先给 .md 算法哲学，再交付可交互 HTML。

say.text: 先写一份 4 到 6 段的算法哲学宣言，再据此实现画面。
say.note: 宣言写入 .md 作为生成依据。

say.text: 把黄金比例这个概念藏在算法里，不直接画出来。
say.note: 概念会被编码进生成逻辑。

howto.what_en: When asked to create art with code, Claude first writes an algorithmic philosophy as a Markdown file, then builds a self-contained p5.js HTML artifact with seeded randomness, adjustable parameters and an interactive viewer; the same seed always reproduces the same output.
howto.when_en: It triggers when the user asks to create art with code, generative art, algorithmic art, or mentions flow fields or particle systems.

say_en.text: Create a flow-field particle art piece in p5.js, with a parameter panel and seed control.
say_en.note: Claude provides a .md philosophy, then an interactive HTML.

say_en.text: Write a 4-6 paragraph algorithmic philosophy manifesto first, then implement the visuals.
say_en.note: The manifesto goes into .md as the basis.

say_en.text: Hide the golden ratio concept inside the algorithm without drawing it literally.
say_en.note: The concept gets encoded into the logic.
